versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Client Onboarding Checklist Generator.
- Generates customized onboarding checklists for service businesses.
- Covers intake, setup, communication, milestones, and success metrics.
- Checklist phases include: Pre-Onboarding, Kick-Off, Setup & Configuration, Stabilization, and Handoff to Ongoing.
- Customizes checklist based on business type, service, client size, and timeline.
- Outputs ready-to-use markdown checklists.
